superevent_rus_restoration.source_title: Plum Brook Reactor Facility Control Room during Facility Startup
superevent_rus_restoration.source_type: Real colour archival photograph; edited and widened using built-in image generation.
superevent_rus_restoration.prompt: Preserve the real Plum Brook reactor control room and distinct people from the archival photograph. Widen to 16:9, retain analog instruments and industrial architecture. Muted grey-green control panels, white lab coats, restrained amber indicators. Photographic archival colour, no invented futuristic technology, captions or frame.

superevent_rus_black_banner.source_title: Archival photograph of Soviet sailors overlooking Port Arthur
superevent_rus_black_banner.source_type: Real photograph used for faces and poses. Uniforms, flag and ruined-city background are edited fiction, not an unaltered historical photograph.

filter.compositing: psd-tools with the embedded Soft_Warming.look RGB 8x8x8 LUT decoded as little-endian float32, red-fastest coordinates, trilinear interpolation; original adjustment values and blend modes. Placeholder image layers hidden. Transparent canvas outside artwork_bbox.
